create_encoder_decoder: create an EncoderDecoder model with encoder and decoder vocab sizes, padding index, and layer counts
run_encoder_decoder_forward: run the EncoderDecoder forward pass with source and target input tensors to get generator output
encode_source_sequence: encode a source sequence with the EncoderDecoder encode method to get memory and padding mask
generate_next_token_logits: generate next token logits from current target sequence, memory, and memory key padding mask
build_positional_encoding: build a _PositionalEncoding module with d_model dimension and max sequence length
